# Sill (Sill 置物岛)

> Drop it at the top of your Mac. Grab it when you need it.

A little space between things. A native macOS 14 or later drag-and-drop shelf for files, images, text, and links.

## Facts
- Sill is a native macOS 14+ app that turns the empty space at the top of the screen into a drag-and-drop shelf.
- Drop a file, image, text snippet, or link onto the shelf, switch apps or Spaces, then drag it back into Finder or any app.
- Core features are free and require no account. Content stays on the local Mac.
- Clipboard is read only after an explicit user action; there is no background clipboard monitoring.
- Small files are copied into Sill's local storage; large files are referenced with macOS security-scoped bookmarks.
- Sill works on Macs with or without a display notch.
- Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase (no subscription).
- Pro unlocks unlimited active items, organization and editing, recovery and sensitive-content protection, custom shortcuts and appearance, built-in dynamic scenes, and the island companion Pobb. Extra skin packs are separate in-app purchases and require permanent Pro access.
- Sill is coming soon to macOS and is not distributed as a direct download from sill-app.com.
- Sill supports English and Simplified Chinese, light and dark appearance, and respects Reduce Motion.

## Key links
- Home: https://sill-app.com/
- Availability: Coming soon on macOS
- Support: https://sill-app.com/support.html (support@sill-app.com)

## FAQ
### Does Sill require an account?
No. Core drag, stash, and retrieve features work without an account. An optional Sill account is used for the Pro trial. Search and organization require Pro.

### Sill 需要账号吗？
不需要。核心拖入、暂存与取回无需账号。可选 Sill 账号用于 Pro 试用；搜索和整理需要 Pro。

### Is Sill a subscription?
No. Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase. Previous purchases can be restored.

### Sill 是订阅制吗？
不是。Sill Pro 是一次性非消耗型内购，可恢复既有购买。

### Does Sill monitor my clipboard in the background?
No. Sill reads the clipboard only after you explicitly trigger a capture. Stashed content stays on your Mac.

### Sill 会在后台监控剪贴板吗？
不会。只有你主动触发抓取时才会读取剪贴板，暂存内容留在本机。

### Does Sill work on a Mac without a notch?
Yes. On a Mac without a notch, the shelf stays centered at the top edge of the display.

### 没有刘海的 Mac 能用吗？
可以。无刘海 Mac 上，置物岛固定在屏幕顶部居中位置。

### What macOS version does Sill require?
Sill requires macOS 14 or later.

### Sill 需要什么系统版本？
需要 macOS 14 或更高版本。
